source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The filter emitter increments currentPart.size before it may discard attachment data. Encryption checks temporarily retain an initial body portion, then endPart clears attachment bodies when excludeAttachmentData is enabled. The body.length < 300 condition is checked before appending an entire chunk, so it is not a hard 300-byte cap. A first large chunk may exceed that value. Manual comment and test proposal for this stream path: distinguish retained data, accounted size and the pre-append threshold. Preserve inline-encryption and encrypted-attachment detection while avoiding retention of the whole attachment. The source does not prove peak memory usage or a fixed chunk size.
title: Count discarded attachment bytes and describe a prefix threshold accurately
